result.stdout:
Usage: altatui [options]

Launches the CodeAlta terminal UI unless a top-level command-line option exits
earlier.

Options:
      --test                 Run the terminal smoke test
      --test-duration=SECONDS
                             Smoke-test duration in SECONDS
      --no-plugins           Disable plugin discovery, build, and load for this
                               process
      --plugin-safe-mode     Disable plugin discovery, build, and load for this
                               process
      --plugins-status       Print plugin discovery/config status and exit
                               without starting the TUI
      --plugins-wait-for-enter
                             Wait for Enter after source plugin live progress
                               finishes
      --dev                  Run as the developer instance: beside the normal
                               one on the same ~/.alta profile, with its own
                               sessions, view state, logs and lock under ~/.
                               alta/dev
  -h, -?, --help             Show this message and exit
  -v, --version              Show the version of this command
